summary_1line: As Rama insists on honoring exile, the brahmin Javali argues against attachment and urges him to abandon the vow and rule Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: The brahmin Javali stands before Rama and Bharata in the forest, passionately arguing while the princes listen beneath tall trees.
Rama, dressed in bark garments in the forest clearing, calmly addresses Bharata while courtiers and sages watch in tense silence.
